name: application-resizable
title: Resizable
description: Split-panel layouts with a draggable divider for resizing adjacent panes in editors, dashboards, and multi-pane application views.
useWhen: Split-panel layouts with a draggable divider for resizing adjacent panes in editors, dashboards, and multi-pane application views.
avoidWhen: Avoid resizable when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Resizable uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
